name: Letter A
description: Both hands form clenched fists with both thumbs pointing upwards and touching at their tips.
tips: Touch your thumb tips together firmly while keeping other fingers tucked in closed fists.

name: Letter B
description: Both hands join index fingers and thumbs into two touching circular loops (resembling eyeglasses or the letter 'B').
tips: Make two 'O' circles with thumb and index finger on each hand and touch the circles together.

name: Letter C
description: One hand curves all fingers and the thumb into a distinct, open 'C' shape facing sideways.
tips: Curve your palm and fingers into an open arc, holding your hand sideways to the camera.

name: Letter D
description: Left index finger points upward while the right hand curves its index finger and thumb to meet it, forming the upright 'D'.
tips: Hold left index finger straight up as the vertical stem; curve right thumb and index into a semicircle touching the left index.

name: Letter E
description: Left hand held open with fingers spread; the right index finger touches the tip of the left index finger (first vowel).
tips: Touch the tip of your left index finger with your right index finger.

name: Letter F
description: Two fingers (index and middle) on both hands cross horizontally over one another in a crossbar formation.
tips: Extend index and middle fingers on both hands and lay one pair across the other like a cross.

name: Letter G
description: Both hands clenched in fists placed horizontally next to each other, knuckles aligned.
tips: Clench both fists and place them side-by-side with knuckles facing forward.

name: Letter H
description: Right hand flat with fingers straight, resting horizontally across the flat upward-facing palm of the left hand.
tips: Lay your flat right palm crosswise on top of your flat left palm.

name: Letter I
description: Left hand held open with fingers spread; the right index finger touches the tip of the left middle finger (second vowel).
tips: Point your right index finger directly at the tip of your left middle finger.

name: Letter J
description: Right index finger touches the tip of the left middle finger and traces the curve of the letter 'J' down onto the palm.
tips: Start at the tip of the left middle finger and trace a hook downward across the palm.

name: Letter K
description: Left index finger held straight up; the right index finger curves and hooks against the left index knuckle.
tips: Left index points upward; right index forms a hook pressing against the middle joint of the left index.

name: Letter L
description: One hand forms a clean 90-degree right angle between the extended thumb and index finger, with other fingers curled.
tips: Extend thumb outward and index finger upward to form a sharp 'L' angle.

name: Letter M
description: Right hand places three extended fingertips (index, middle, ring) downwards onto the open flat palm of the left hand.
tips: Rest three fingertips (index, middle, ring) of your right hand downward on your flat left palm.

name: Letter N
description: Right hand places two extended fingertips (index and middle) downwards onto the open flat palm of the left hand.
tips: Rest two fingertips (index and middle) of your right hand downward on your flat left palm.

name: Letter O
description: Left hand held open with fingers spread; the right index finger touches the tip of the left ring finger (fourth vowel).
tips: Touch the tip of your left ring finger with the tip of your right index finger.

name: Letter P
description: Left index finger points vertically upward; right index finger and thumb form a loop touching near the top of the left index.
tips: Left index finger held vertical; right thumb and index make a circular loop touching the upper left index finger.

name: Letter Q
description: Left hand forms a circular loop with thumb and index finger; the right index finger hooks into the loop from above.
tips: Make a circle with left thumb and index; hook your right index finger into the circle from the top.

name: Letter R
description: Right index finger curled into a gentle hook shape and placed horizontally against the open palm of the left hand.
tips: Curl right index finger into a ring/hook and place it flat against your open left palm.

name: Letter S
description: Both hands hook their little fingers (pinkies) together securely in a linked lock.
tips: Extend both pinky fingers and hook them tightly together while tucking other fingers in.

name: Letter T
description: Right extended index finger touches perpendicular to the outer edge of the upright left hand.
tips: Keep left hand open vertically; touch your right index finger horizontally against its outer palm edge.

name: Letter U
description: Left hand held open with fingers spread; the right index finger touches the tip of the left little finger (fifth vowel).
tips: Touch the tip of your left pinky finger with the tip of your right index finger.

name: Letter V
description: Right hand forms a distinct 'V' victory shape with index and middle fingers, resting gently on the open palm of the left hand.
tips: Make a 'V' peace sign with right index and middle fingers, and set their tips onto your open left palm.

name: Letter W
description: Both hands interlock all fingers diagonally with fingertips pointing upward in a weave.
tips: Intertwine the fingers of both hands together pointing diagonally upwards like a basket weave.

name: Letter X
description: Both index fingers are extended and crossed over each other at their midpoints to form an 'X'.
tips: Extend both index fingers and cross them across each other to make a crisp 'X' cross.

name: Letter Y
description: Right extended index finger touches directly into the cleft (V-space) between the thumb and index finger of the left open hand.
tips: Open left hand with thumb wide; touch right index finger right into the web between left thumb and index.

name: Letter Z
description: Left open palm held vertical with fingertips pointing upward; right fingertips touch horizontally against the left palm surface.
tips: Hold left hand open facing sideways; place your right fingertips horizontally flat against the left palm.
